## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 64 captures during October 2021. The activity provides the basis for the site’s image review and grading results for the month. Records should continue to be completed consistently so that capture activity can be monitored alongside image quality and grading outcomes.

The clinic lead has asked that any recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. This will support follow-up and help identify equipment or process issues that may affect future activity.

## Image quality

All 64 captures were suitable for assessment. The ungradable count was 0, and the ungradable rate was 0.0 per cent. This indicates that no images were excluded from grading because of image quality during the reporting period.

## Grading

Grading identified 9 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 3. The result should be considered with the activity and image quality findings above when reviewing site performance for October 2021. Consistent recording of capture, image quality and grading information will support routine monitoring and any required operational follow-up.
